create.title: Create Bingo Card
create.freeSpaceTooltip: Leaves an empty tile in the center, typically a freebie for everyone.
create.publicTooltip: Allows anyone with the link to view and play your card.
create.communityTooltip: Enables real-time synchronization so everyone can play together.
create.uploadLogo: Upload Event Logo (Saved locally in IndexedDB)
create.uploadLogoDragPaste: Drag & drop, click to browse, or copy/paste an image (Ctrl+V)
create.logoHelp: For copyright safety, your logo never touches our servers. It is stored solely in your browser's local cache.

game.clearTextsConfirmTitle: ⚠️ Confirm clearing all texts and images?
game.clearTextsConfirmDesc: This action will permanently delete all cell texts and background images on this card (except the central Free Space). This cannot be undone. Are you sure?

share.title: Share Template
share.desc: Share this board template with others! Opening this link will allow them to import a copy of your card completely privately in their own browser.
share.warning: Note: Local image uploads (saved directly from your files) are excluded from the link to keep it short. Only external image URLs and card configuration/texts will be shared.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.p1_text: By accessing and using Bingo Gamer, you accept and agree to be bound by the terms and provision of this agreement. If you do not agree to abide by the above, please do not use this service.
terms.p2_text: Bingo Gamer provides an interactive web-based bingo application for gaming events. The service is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind.
terms.p3_text: You agree not to use the service for any unlawful purpose or in any way that interrupts, damages, or impairs the service.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.p1_text: Bingo Gamer does not collect, transmit, or store any personal data on our servers. All game progress, custom images, and settings are stored locally on your device.
privacy.p2_text: We do not integrate with third-party tracking or analytics services that collect your personal information.
privacy.p3_text: Since all data is stored locally in your browser, you have complete control over it. You can delete all application data by clearing your browser's site data.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.p1_text: Cookies and local storage are small text files or data stored on your device by your web browser.
cookies.p2_text: We strictly use local storage mechanisms (like IndexedDB and localStorage) to save your bingo card configurations, dark/light mode preferences, and language settings. We do not use tracking or advertising cookies.
cookies.p3_text: You can manage or delete these stored settings directly from your browser's settings or by using the clear features within the application.
